verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own month-end close feature, AI Close, which uses AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies. It also documents bank and card reconciliation and accrual-basis accounting. Nothing shows a close checklist that tracks each item's status or records reviewer sign-offs. Missing for 10: a documented close checklist with task tracking, accrual-specific close tasks, review/sign-off workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
